d.subject: CONFIRMED SRC+TST: same non-overflow hinge batch can produce schedule-dependent privileged actions
d.head: 98a7c1cde9fd36d47562b40fa25ed0b094038e70
d.finding: drainHingeIngress replays samples one-by-one into a coordinator that immediately launches IO for WakeInner/BeginPrewarm. The IO generation check races later samples from the same already-drained batch, so identical semantic input can either reach shell or be suppressed depending on scheduling. Opening reversal has no compensating wake action.
d.next: batch-final privileged-effect planning; do not simply defer stale action objects because valid wake intent may need generation promotion
